shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: The skill shot award cycles here before every plunge, including the plunge that follows a physical lock in the jail. Your first plunge of the game is fixed on Advance Hold 'Em so you start with hole cards.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: One of the six red-arrow shots. Collects side pots during multiball and flashes the left-hand chip trick shots.

shots.name: Left Spinner
shots.notes: Feeds the main pot. Each spin adds 5K, and that per-spin figure grows by 500 for every hold 'em hand you have completed.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Advances your hold 'em hand through Flop, Turn and River, and it is the 1M jackpot shot during No Limit Multiball.

shots.name: VUK
shots.notes: A vertical kicker that throws the ball the full height of the cabinet up to the mini-playfield. Carries Cut the Cards, extra ball and a No Limit lock.

shots.name: Scoop
shots.notes: Starts Poker Corner modes and Poker Wizard, holds a No Limit lock, and spots a random drop target when Spin a Card is lit.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: The mirror of the left ramp for hold 'em progress. Both ramps are the scoring engine of the WPT World Championship.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Side pots during multiball, and it flashes the right-hand chip trick shots.

shots.name: Right Spinner
shots.notes: The other half of the main pot builder. Two or three clean orbits will normally tip the pot over the All In threshold.

shots.name: Left Standup
shots.notes: The No Limit qualifier. Three hits light the locks the first time around.

shots.name: Mini-Playfield
shots.notes: The upper deck the VUK feeds. Everything up here is played with its own flippers, and the far right slot drops you back into the pop bumpers.

shots.name: Re-light Mystery Target
shots.notes: The leftmost shot on the mini-playfield. Re-arms Cut the Cards, and it is the target of the Skill Flip.

shots.name: White Standups
shots.notes: Three white targets on the mini-playfield. Three hits start a hurry-up, and further hits push its value back up.

shots.name: Ace in the Hole Jail
shots.notes: Hit the bars to open them, then a ball can be physically locked inside. An open jail during any multiball is free value — locking briefly lights ball save and puts a fresh ball into play.

shots.name: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Three hits release it and start Ace in the Hole Multiball. Late in that multiball each hit is a 1.5M super jackpot.

shots.name: Mini-Playfield Exit
shots.notes: The right-hand slot that drops the ball into the pop bumpers. Cashing a hurry-up means finishing it here.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Three of them, 1K base. They also push the side pot value up, so time in the pops during multiball is not wasted time.

shots.name: Red Standup Targets
shots.notes: Four targets above the pops that do the job rollover lanes usually do. Cycle them with the flipper buttons; completing all four raises bumper value and adds a bonus multiplier.

shots.name: Left Drop Bank
shots.notes: Eight targets — the biggest of the three banks. Clearing this one is worth a 3X relit jackpot during No Limit Multiball.

shots.name: Center Drop Bank
shots.notes: Four targets carrying the card values you build poker hands from. Clearing it relights the No Limit jackpot at 1X.

shots.name: Right Drop Bank
shots.notes: Four targets. Worth a 2X relit jackpot during No Limit Multiball.

shots.name: Poker Hand Inserts
shots.notes: The ladder of hands under the centre bank, from one pair up to royal flush. Lit cards carry from ball to ball even though the targets reset upright.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Re-lights Spin a Card at the scoop and flashes the right-hand chip tricks.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Flashes the left-hand chip tricks. Triple scoring lights on one inlane and you can move it to the other with a flipper button.

shots.name: Upper Playfield Left Flipper
shots.notes: The left of the mini-playfield's own pair of flippers — every shot up on the deck is made from these, not from the main flippers. Position estimated, at the bottom-left of the deck's target cluster.

shots.name: Upper Playfield Right Flipper
shots.notes: The right of the mini-playfield's own pair of flippers. Position estimated, symmetric with the left one.

goals.title: Skill Shot
goals.summary: The award cycles before you plunge, so look before you pull. Advance Hold 'Em moves your hand along, Mystery pays a Cut the Cards award, and Skill Flip asks you to hit the leftmost mini-playfield shot without touching another switch for 1M, climbing by 1M per collection up to 5M.
goals.reward: Hand advance, mystery award, or 1M to 5M

steps.action: Watch the cycle, then plunge when Skill Flip shows
steps.detail: The award cycles on the display while the ball waits — launch as Skill Flip comes up to take it.

goals.title: Build Hold 'Em Hands
goals.summary: The ramps deal your cards. Each ramp shot moves you Flop to Turn to River, and completing a hand pays the main pot multiplied by how strong the hand landed. Completed hands also light Poker Corner and push you through the tournament ladder.
goals.reward: Main pot x hand strength, lights Poker Corner

steps.detail: Either ramp advances the hand, so take whichever your flipper is already set for.

steps.action: Ramp again for Turn and River
steps.detail: Completing the hand pays out and lights the scoop for a Poker Corner mode.

goals.title: Hand Strength Multipliers
goals.summary: A completed hand pays the current main pot times a multiplier set by the hand you were dealt. That multiplier swings the payout by a factor of eighteen, which is why building the pot before finishing a hand matters so much.
instructions: High card pays half the pot, a pair pays it once, two pair doubles it.
Three of a kind is 3x, a straight 4x, a flush 5x, a full house 6x.
Four of a kind is 7x, a straight flush 8x, and a royal flush 9x.
In tournament play the hands arrive in ascending strength — you are dealt a pair first, and it improves from there.
The practical takeaway: work the spinners to fatten the pot before you finish a strong hand, not after.

goals.title: Fatten The Main Pot
goals.summary: The main pot starts at 250K and grows 25K for every hand you complete. Every spinner rotation adds 5K on top, and that per-spin figure itself grows by 500 per completed hand. The pot is both your hand payout and the All In trigger.
goals.reward: Larger hand payouts, All In Multiball

steps.detail: A full orbit rather than a rattled entry is what gets you the whole spin count.
Two or three clean orbits will normally take the pot to the All In threshold.

goals.title: Win Tournaments
goals.summary: The red inserts between the slingshots track your tournament run. One completed hand wins the first for 1M, two hands wins the second for 1.5M, three hands the third for 2M. Everything after that needs four hands and pays 500K more than the last.

steps.detail: Hands are the only currency tournaments accept.

steps.action: Sweep the lit arrows after each win
steps.detail: Winning lights the red arrow inserts for 100K apiece and they go dark once collected.

steps.action: Push to the second and sixth wins
steps.detail: Extra ball lights after tournament two and again after tournament six, and the sixth opens the WPT World Championship.

goals.title: Poker Corner Modes
goals.summary: Every completed hand lights one Poker Corner mode at the scoop. Modes run 30 seconds, each has a goal worth a Trophy, and every Trophy is 1M and raises the Poker Wizard payout. Relights do not stack, so a mode you skip costs you a whole hand.

steps.detail: That lights the scoop and nothing else does.
Starting one also re-arms the Ace in the Hole lock, which is a free tempo gain.

steps.action: Buy time with Cut the Cards
steps.detail: The first mystery award collected during a running mode adds 15 seconds to it.

goals.title: The Six Mode Goals
goals.summary: Each Poker Corner mode has one specific requirement for the Trophy. Knowing the requirement before the mode starts is worth more than any shot skill — half of these are lost simply because the player is shooting the wrong thing for 30 seconds.
instructions: Steal the Blinds: one shot is the Big Blind at 500K, the rest are Small Blinds at 100K. Make any shot and the Big Blind gains 100K while the small ones gain 25K; every bumper hit raises the Big Blind and relocates it. Two Big Blinds collected wins the Trophy.

Play the Button: the flashing arrow starts at 500K, unlit shots at 50K. Any shot adds 100K to the flashing value and 10K to the unlit one, and the button jumps to the leftmost shot after every hit. Three flashing shots wins it.

Know Your Outs: drops pay 250K plus 25K each, capped at 750K per target, and stay down until all sixteen fall. Sixteen drops wins the Trophy and the full clear pays a bonus of 1M plus 500K per previous clear.
A Chip and a Chair: drops pay 100K plus 10K each and reset immediately. You need twenty of them.
Spot the Tell: six faces map to the six main shots. Hit the one showing the tell for 1M plus 250K per tell found; the rest pay 100K plus 25K. Two tells wins it.
Change Gears: lower shots start at 500K and cap at 1.5M, mini-playfield white targets start at 300K and cap at 750K, and each hit raises both. Eight shots wins it.
Tournament note: the two drop target modes are safe to ignore rather than time out, and Change Gears is worth saving until you have a multiball you can start quickly.

goals.title: Ace in the Hole Multiball
goals.summary: Knock the bars to open the jail, then work the captive ball — three hits free it and start the multiball. Both balls begin up on the mini-playfield, and re-locking one straight away is worth an instant 1M and a third ball.

steps.detail: Four bar hits open them; after the captive ball is released it takes another four to reopen.

steps.action: Hit the captive ball three times
steps.detail: Let a ball leave the mini-playfield and the bars drop, leaving you a two-ball multiball instead.

steps.action: Cash jackpots at the jail and ramps
steps.detail: They open at 200K and climb to 400K and 500K.
The jail reopens after three jackpots; locking adds another ball and briefly lights ball save.
Around ten jackpots in, with a ball back in the jail, every captive ball hit is 1.5M.

goals.title: All In Multiball
goals.summary: This one starts itself. Push the main pot up with the orbit spinners until it reaches the All In figure — 750K the first time, 250K higher every time after. You are handed a completed hand and the pot's base value the moment it starts.
goals.reward: A free hand, the pot, and 150K jackpots

steps.detail: Two or three good full orbits usually does it, or one with triple scoring running.
Jackpots are on all the main shots bar the orbits, starting at 150K and rising with switch hits.

steps.action: Take side pots with the orbits instead
steps.detail: Orbits are not jackpots here, so use them for side pot credit.

goals.title: No Limit Multiball
goals.summary: Three hits on the left standup lights all three locks the first time, and you can bank them one after another at the VUK or the scoop. The second No Limit is stricter: light one lock, collect it, then light the next.

steps.detail: Watch the lock insert — it flashes when the third lock is lit.

steps.action: Lock at the scoop or the VUK
steps.detail: With two balls locked and Poker Corner also lit, one scoop shot starts a mode and the multiball together.
That is the jackpot shot for the whole multiball.

steps.action: Relight it off a drop bank
steps.detail: Centre bank relights at 1X, right bank at 2X, left bank at 3X — the eight-target bank is worth the extra work.

goals.title: Drop Target Poker
goals.summary: The drops are a deck. Knock down the cards that make a hand and its insert lights, paying 100K times the hand's position on the ladder plus 100K for every unlit hand beneath it. Royal flush pays 1M base. Lit cards carry between balls.

steps.action: Make a hand out of the drops
steps.detail: Two queens light one pair; each drop itself pays 10K, climbing 1K at a time.
Completing a straight before a pair pays 400K plus 300K for the three hands still dark below it.

steps.action: Use Spin a Card to fill gaps
steps.detail: The scoop spots a random drop when lit; re-light it through the left inlane.

goals.title: Poker Hands Multiball
goals.summary: Light every hand on the ladder and you get a four-ball multiball — the game's mini wizard mode. Jackpots open at 1M, the spinners push them higher, and the ninth jackpot lights a 5M super. It can be started on top of another multiball.

steps.detail: Progress is frozen during Know Your Outs and A Chip and a Chair because those modes own the drops.
They start at 1M.
Spinners raise the jackpot value while the multiball runs.

goals.title: Triple Scoring
goals.summary: Complete a drop target poker hand and triple scoring lights on one inlane. Three seconds, everything scoring tripled — and it counts as triple progress toward super jackpots, which is the part most players miss.

steps.action: Finish a hand off the drops
steps.detail: Any completed hand lights it.

steps.action: Move it to the correct inlane
steps.detail: A flipper button swaps which inlane holds the light, so put it where your next shot is.
A tripled spinner rip into the pot, or a jackpot during multiball, are the two best uses.

goals.title: Chip Tricks
goals.summary: These are the combos. The left orbit and right inlane flash the left-side chip trick shots; the right orbit and left inlane flash the right-side ones. Every major shot except the VUK carries one. Spot your fifth and Super Trick begins.

steps.detail: The right inlane does the same job if the ball comes down that side.
Chaining them straight together pays 2X and 3X the value, and the base rises for the rest of the ball.

steps.action: Keep the Super Trick clock alive
steps.detail: The fifth trick starts a rolling 10-second timer paying roughly 200K, then 300K, then 400K as you keep hitting flashing shots.

steps.action: Clear them all for the extra ball
steps.detail: Hitting every flashing trick during Super Trick lights an extra ball you must collect on that same ball.

goals.title: Cut the Cards
goals.summary: The mystery award, and the longest shot on the machine — the VUK fires the ball off the back of the playfield and up to the mini-playfield. Awards run from small points to hold values, bonus multipliers, opening the jail and, rarely, an extra ball.
goals.reward: Mystery award, add-a-ball, or mode time

steps.detail: During any multiball this awards an extra ball into play instead, unless all four are already out.
The leftmost mini-playfield shot re-lights Cut the Cards.
Collected during a running mode it buys 15 more seconds instead of an award.

goals.title: Hurry-Ups
goals.summary: Three hits on the white mini-playfield targets start a hurry-up at 1M and it bleeds down from there. More white target hits push the number back up, and you bank it by dropping through the right-hand slot into the pops.
goals.reward: Up to 1M, hold awards, extra ball at ten

steps.detail: Hits during the hurry-up raise the running value.

steps.action: Cash it in the exit slot
steps.detail: That is the only shot that collects it.
Every second hurry-up hands out a random hold award, and ten of them light the extra ball.

goals.title: Side Pots
goals.summary: Side pots exist only during multiball, and only on the orbits. Each starts at 100K and the pop bumpers push it up. Ten side pots lights an extra ball, so orbits during a long multiball are never a wasted shot.
goals.reward: 100K and up, extra ball at ten

steps.detail: Bumper hits raise the side pot value before you collect it.
The value resets each ball unless a hold award has protected it.
Every multiball can be stacked with the others, so side pot chances come in bunches.

goals.title: Red Targets And Bonus X
goals.summary: The four red targets above the pops stand in for the usual rollover lanes, and the flipper buttons cycle which ones are lit. Complete the set to raise the pop bumper value and add a bonus multiplier.

steps.detail: Move the lit targets to match where the ball is going rather than aiming at a specific one.
Bumpers pay 1K flat until you raise them, and they also feed the side pot.

goals.title: End-Of-Ball Bonus
goals.summary: The bonus is a quiet running total of everything you have finished rather than everything you have hit, so it rewards closing things out. Most of it survives from ball to ball.
instructions: 10K for every hold 'em hand you have completed, counted across the whole game.
50K for every mode Trophy, also cumulative.
A sharpshooter component of 500 times your hand level times the drop targets left standing — this one is per ball.
The four red targets above the pops each completion adds a bonus multiplier, which is the cheapest way to grow the whole figure.

goals.title: Poker Wizard
goals.summary: Play all six Poker Corner modes and the scoop lights for Poker Wizard. The payout is set by how many Trophies you actually earned — two Trophies makes jackpots 1.6M, three makes them 2.3M, four makes them 3.1M.

steps.detail: Playing a mode qualifies it; the Trophy is what sets the price.
This is why timing out a mode without its Trophy costs you twice.

goals.title: WPT World Championship
goals.summary: Winning your sixth tournament opens this one. It is a ramp grind: collect 10M from flops, turns and rivers, with the hand awards themselves boosted by hitting drop targets. Finishing it pays another 10M.

steps.detail: Every stage of the hand scores here, so the shot never goes cold.
You need 10M banked before it ends.
Drop targets raise the hand awards you are collecting.

goals.title: Keefer Invitational
goals.summary: The final mode, and it asks for a complete game. Win the World Championship, then score 25M in each of six separate categories, then take one more Cut the Cards award to start it. It pays 25M up front plus a four-ball multiball.

steps.detail: Ace in the Hole, No Limit, the pot from completed hands, targets, hurry-ups and Poker Corner all need 25M each.

steps.action: Start it with Cut the Cards
steps.detail: Once the six criteria are met, the next mystery award opens the mode.
All shots pay 1M, spinners 25K and bumpers 50K; locking in the jail and hitting the captive ball raises the jackpot.

steps.action: Clear drops for an extra ball
steps.detail: A completed bank pays 2M and adds a ball. Hurry-ups run continuously here, starting at 2M.

achievements.title: Skill Flip
achievements.desc: Land the Skill Flip on the mini-playfield without touching another switch.

achievements.title: River Card
achievements.desc: Complete your first hold 'em hand through the ramps.

achievements.title: All In
achievements.desc: Push the main pot over the All In threshold with the spinners.

achievements.title: First Trophy
achievements.desc: Complete a Poker Corner mode goal and take the Trophy.

achievements.title: Instant Re-Lock
achievements.desc: Re-lock a ball in the jail straight away for the 1M award.

achievements.title: Super Trick
achievements.desc: Spot five chip tricks and start Super Trick.

achievements.title: Royal Flush
achievements.desc: Light the royal flush insert off the drop targets.

achievements.title: Full Ladder
achievements.desc: Light every poker hand and start Poker Hands Multiball.

achievements.title: Poker Wizard
achievements.desc: Play all six Poker Corner modes and start Poker Wizard.

achievements.title: World Champion
achievements.desc: Win six tournaments and complete the WPT World Championship.

achievements.title: The Invitational
achievements.desc: Meet all six 25M criteria and start the Keefer Invitational.

drills.title: Time The Skill Flip
drills.text: Let the award cycle run on the display and launch exactly as Skill Flip comes up, then hit the leftmost mini-playfield shot without touching another switch on the way. The value climbs a million each time you collect it, so this is a plunge worth watching rather than pulling.

drills.title: Spinners Before Ramps
drills.text: Rip both orbit spinners with full clean orbits rather than rattled entries, and hold your ramp shots until the pot is fat. The same completed hand pays anywhere from half the pot to nine times it, so the order you shoot in is worth more than the shots themselves.
drills.reps: 3 hands, pot built first each time

drills.title: Three Seconds Of Triple
drills.text: Finish a poker hand off the centre drops, tap the flipper button to slide the lit inlane insert to the side your next shot is on, and spend the window on a spinner rip. Three seconds is one shot, so the shot has to be chosen before the hand completes.

drills.title: Start Upstairs, Cash Downstairs
drills.text: On the mini-playfield, take the three white standups to start the hurry-up, keep hitting them to push the value back up, and only then drop through the right-hand slot. The exit is the only shot that banks it, so leaving early throws the whole number away.

drills.title: Chip Trick Chains
drills.text: The left orbit and right inlane flash the left-side tricks; the right orbit and left inlane flash the right-side ones, so know which half is live before you shoot. Chained straight together they pay double and triple, and the base value stays up for the rest of the ball.

drills.title: Keep A Ball In The Jail
drills.text: Open the bars, free the captive ball, and then hold both balls on the mini-playfield long enough to re-lock one straight away — a ball leaving the deck drops the bars and costs you the third ball. Re-lock again every three jackpots to keep the ball save cycling.

actionButton.how: No action button on this 2006 Stern. What it does have is a second pair of flipper buttons for the mini playfield upstairs, which takes over once the VUK fires your ball onto the top deck. Down below, tapping a flipper button also slides the lit triple-scoring insert from one inlane to the other.

howItPlays.objective: World Poker Tour is a Texas hold 'em machine: the ramps deal your hand, the spinners build the pot, and a strong hand pays the pot several times over. Win six tournaments and play out all six Poker Corner modes on the way to the Keefer Invitational, the game's final table.
loop: Shoot either ramp to deal your hold 'em cards from the Flop to the Turn to the River, and rip the orbit spinners to grow the pot before a strong hand cashes out.
Completing a hand pays the pot times the hand's strength and lights a Poker Corner mode at the scoop; each mode goal you finish banks a Trophy.
Knock down drop-target cards to light poker hands on the ladder, and cycle the red targets with the flippers for a cheap bonus multiplier.
Light locks on the left standup for No Limit, work the jail and captive ball for Ace in the Hole, and let the pot trigger All In on its own.
Win six tournaments to open the WPT World Championship, and play all six modes to reach Poker Wizard and, finally, the Keefer Invitational.

lights.name: Hold 'Em Hands
lights.lit: Each ramp shot moves your hold 'em hand one street along -- Flop, then Turn, then River -- and either ramp works, so play whichever one your flipper is lined up on.
lights.then: Complete the hand to collect the main pot multiplied by the hand you were dealt, and to light a Poker Corner mode at the scoop. Grow the pot on the spinners first, because the multiplier swings the same pot from half its value to nine times it.

lights.name: Main Pot & All In
lights.lit: The spinners build the main pot -- five thousand a spin, and that per-spin figure climbs with every hand you complete -- so the same pot is both what a finished hand pays you and the trigger for All In.
lights.then: Rip full clean orbits rather than rattled entries to push the pot up fast. Reach the All In figure and All In Multiball starts on its own, handing you a free completed hand and the pot's value the moment it begins.

lights.name: Poker Corner Modes
lights.lit: Each hold 'em hand you finish arms a Poker Corner mode at the scoop; every mode lasts thirty seconds and hangs a Trophy on one specific goal.
lights.then: Begin the lit mode and clear its single requirement for the Trophy, worth a million and a bump to the eventual Poker Wizard value. A skipped mode does not queue up again -- letting one lapse throws away a full hand of setup.

lights.name: Poker Hand Ladder
lights.lit: A hand ladder sits below the centre drop bank, from a single pair on up to the royal flush; drop the target-cards that complete a hand and that rung lights, and a lit rung sticks even after the targets pop back upright.
lights.then: Skip ahead on purpose -- completing a straight before a pair pays for the dark hands beneath it as well. Light every hand on the ladder to start Poker Hands Multiball, the four-ball mini wizard whose ninth jackpot lights a five-million super.

lights.name: No Limit Locks
lights.lit: Three hits on the left standup light all three No Limit locks the first time through; the second No Limit is stricter, lighting one lock at a time.
lights.flashing: The lock insert flashes when the third lock is lit and ready to bank.
lights.then: Bank the locks at the VUK or the scoop, and if a Poker Corner mode is lit with two balls already down, a single scoop shot kicks off that mode and No Limit at once. The one-million jackpot is the left ramp; a drop bank relights it -- the centre at 1X, right at 2X, and the eight-target left bank at 3X.

lights.name: Ace in the Hole
lights.lit: Knock the jail bars open and go to work on the captive ball behind them -- a third hit springs it loose and launches the multiball, with both balls dropping in up on the mini-playfield.
lights.then: Re-lock a ball the instant the multiball starts for a one-million award and a spare ball, then keep re-locking as the jail reopens so ball save stays live. Deeper in, once a ball is parked back in the jail, each captive-ball strike pays a 1.5-million super.

lights.name: Red Target Lanes
lights.lit: The four red targets above the pop bumpers stand in for the usual top rollover lanes; a lit target is one you still need, and it goes dark once you strike it.

control.effect: one tap of either flipper button cycles which of the four red targets are lit, so you can slide the lit ones onto the path the ball is taking through the pops rather than trying to pick off one fixed target
control.when: while the ball is bouncing around the pop bumpers, before it settles out

lights.then: Slide the lit targets under the ball and clear all four to push up the pops and step your bonus multiplier -- the cheapest multiplier here. Those hotter pops then also feed the side pot in any multiball.

lights.name: Triple Scoring
lights.lit: Sink a poker hand off the drops and triple scoring lights on one inlane for a few seconds; roll that lit inlane and everything triples -- and, easy to overlook, your progress toward super jackpots triples along with it.

control.effect: one tap of either flipper button shifts the lit triple-scoring insert across to the other inlane, so you can park it on the side the ball is about to return down
control.when: in the three-second window after a drop-target hand lights it, before the ball reaches a return lane

lights.then: Put the light where your next shot is, then spend the three seconds on the biggest thing available -- a spinner rip into the pot, or a multiball jackpot. The window is one shot long, so choose it before the hand completes.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap either flipper button to cycle which of the four red targets above the pops are lit -- they stand in for the usual top rollover lanes. Line the lit ones up with the ball's path and clear all four to boost the pops and step your bonus multiplier. That same tap also shifts the lit triple-scoring insert between the two inlanes, so you can park it where your next shot will come back.

scoring.text: Watch the skill-shot award cycle and take the Skill Flip when it shows, then deal hands on the ramps and grow the main pot on the spinners before finishing a strong hand. Cycle the red targets for a cheap bonus multiplier.

Bank Poker Corner Trophies at the scoop, start No Limit and Ace in the Hole multiballs, and let the pot trigger All In. Use a drop-target hand to light triple scoring and spend the window on your biggest shot.

The deepest run stacks three finales: play all six Poker Corner modes for Poker Wizard, win your sixth tournament to open the WPT World Championship, then meet twenty-five million in six separate categories and take one more Cut the Cards to start the Keefer Invitational, worth twenty-five million and a four-ball multiball.
